postgres_requirements.rationale: A real PostgreSQL probe is MANDATORY for the base manifest's ENGINE ARM (its P4..P11) and cannot be replaced by static reading of the authority's prose: catalog-resolution privilege semantics (to_regprocedure vs has_schema_privilege vs has_function_privilege), read-only-transaction SET ROLE escalation, and PUBLIC-derived CONNECT/TEMP are runtime properties, not static facts. Both harness paths are legitimately UNKNOWN at this base because no db/prepared/** package exists for this capability yet — the base authority's MR-3 delivery package is gated behind a protected-surface allocation this lane does not hold (GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION), so no implementing mission and no test-file location has been chosen. What IS frozen and may not vary: the cluster is DISPOSABLE ONLY, via scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts (tests/postgres/disposable-db.ts, gated UELLIX_PG_TESTS=1, skipped never silently passed) or an equivalent throwaway container created and destroyed per run with positive absence verification — NEVER staging, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local Supabase development stack, carried unchanged from the base authority's ENGINE_SEMANTICS_MEASURED.substrate.not_the_canonical_local_stack. The base authority's E-1..E-11 and mutants M4/M5/M7/M8/M13/M36 were already measured once by the authoring lane on a throwaway PostgreSQL 17.10 container and INDEPENDENTLY RE-MEASURED, identically, by the certifying lane (CV1-D1-AUDITOR-CAPABILITY-IC-R1) on public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.155 — the EXACT image build the staging target runs (server_version_num 170006) — which closed the base authority's OF-3/KG-4 engine-version-delta disclosure by measurement rather than by argument, before this amendment existed. The implementing mission MUST replace both UNKNOWNs with real paths once P4..P11 are encoded as a repeatable pg.test.ts, and MUST NOT close P4..P11 or P18 with either still UNKNOWN.

sentinels.purpose: A fabricated, non-functional connection string (fake host, random non-secret password, role name uellix_auditor) substituted for UELLIX_AUDITOR_DATABASE_URL in every fixture that exercises MR-2, PHASE_P4 delivery or PHASE_P4 removal. It must never resolve to a reachable target and must never be a real credential. Its purpose is to make SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT and SECRET_DELIVERY_CONTRACT's 'no secret VALUE appears anywhere' rule ASSERTABLE rather than merely declared: the implementing tests grep every retained artifact this node's controls touch (the capability evidence artifact draft, any captured command output, the PR body) for the sentinel's exact bytes and fail red if it is found anywhere it is not the fixture's own input. It is the credential analogue of a canary string — exactly the schema's own example, 'a generated password never appears in tool output' — and it MUST NOT be reused across runs: a fresh value per test run, so a match cannot be confused with a stale leak from a previous execution. Directly exercises base manifest controls N14, N15, M14, M15 and M16, none of which are edited by this amendment.

A uniquely-valued marker planted alongside SENTINEL_SYNTHETIC_AUDITOR_DSN at the moment it is delivered to the consuming process's environment (PHASE_P4), read back by the implementing test to positively CONFIRM presence before removal and positively CONFIRM absence after it, on both the success and the failure path. Its purpose is to make POSITIVE_ABSENCE_VERIFICATION a measured assertion rather than an assumption that a removal command's exit code implies its effect: the control must actually re-read the target location and find the marker gone, not merely infer removal from having issued a delete. Directly exercises base manifest controls N15 and M26, neither edited by this amendment.

positive_controls.description: AMENDMENT ARM. postgres_requirements AND sentinels NOW CONFORM TO SCHEMA SHAPE. This amendment’s own postgres_requirements is an object carrying setup_manifest, probe_manifest and rationale (matching docs/ops/ods/UELLIX_TEST_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_v1.0.0.json properties.postgres_requirements: type object, required [probe_manifest, rationale]), and its own sentinels is an array of exactly two {id, purpose} objects (matching properties.sentinels: type array, items required [id, purpose]). Both must be confirmed by an ACTUAL VALIDATOR RUN against the live schema file, not by inspection: load both JSON documents, walk the schema’s required/type declarations for these two properties, and assert zero violations against THIS amendment’s copies. The base manifest’s own copies of these two fields are superseded per SECTION_A1 of the companion authority amendment and must not be read for shape or content; this amendment’s copies control for the node.

AMENDMENT ARM. FAIL_CLOSED_TOKENS IS NOW TOTAL OVER POSTSTATE_VERIFICATION.prohibited_privileges_absent. The companion authority amendment’s SECTION_A5 adds STOP_UNEXPLAINED_PROHIBITED_PRIVILEGE, which base manifest control P16 (unchanged, still controlling, still asserting “every branch ... must terminate in a token that exists in FAIL_CLOSED_TOKENS”) now requires for PV-24..PV-28 to have a terminal token when red and unattributable to MR-3. Re-running P16’s own check — walking FUTURE_EXECUTION_PHASES, CAPABILITY_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT and POSTSTATE_VERIFICATION for every named branch and confirming each terminates in a token present in the (now twenty-three-member) FAIL_CLOSED_TOKENS.tokens array — must find zero unterminated branches, where before this amendment it found the PV-24..28 branch unterminated.

negative_controls.description: AMENDMENT ARM, PROVING THE SHAPE DEFECT WAS REAL AND IS REPRODUCIBLE. A manifest whose postgres_requirements or sentinels is a bare STRING must FAIL validation against the object/array shape docs/ops/ods/UELLIX_TEST_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_v1.0.0.json requires. Run the validator against the UNAMENDED base manifest at blob 2790f3530ce44fd77e12ecdf49430d93ec7a4a70 (git show that blob rather than reading the live working file, so the control is anchored to the exact frozen bytes this amendment responds to) and confirm it reports exactly two shape violations: postgres_requirements is type string, not object; sentinels is type string, not array. A validator implementation that reports zero violations against that exact blob is ITSELF DEFECTIVE and this control must be reported FAILED — never silently counted as “the base manifest actually passed after all.”

AMENDMENT ARM. OD-4 AND OD-6 REMAIN BLOCKING DESPITE HAVING NO DIRECT MUTATION DEPENDENCY. A future lane that opens PHASE_P1 with OD-4 or OD-6 unratified — reasoning from the base authority text’s original “NONE for P1..P5”, or from the companion amendment’s SECTION_A4 “no direct technical dependency” language, read out of context — must still be refused: FAIL_CLOSED_TOKENS.STOP_OWNER_DECISION_UNRATIFIED fires per OWNER_DECISIONS.rule, PHASE_P0_PREREQUISITE.gate and this base manifest’s own N16 (all three unchanged by the companion amendment, all three name OD-1..OD-6 without exception). A run that proceeds with OD-4 or OD-6 unratified fails this control regardless of what SECTION_A4 says about why they were cheap to ratify — cheap to ratify is not a licence to skip ratifying.

mutation_controls.description: MUTANT — READ THE OD-4/OD-6 HARMONIZED TEXT AS A SILENT WEAKENING. Interpret SECTION_A4’s “no direct technical dependency” as authorization to proceed with those two owner decisions unratified. Expected: AN2 goes RED, and the base authority’s FACT_VS_RECOMMENDATION_VS_DECISION.OWNER_DECISION clause (unchanged, still reading “OD-1..OD-6 ... Unratified, they BLOCK P1 with STOP_OWNER_DECISION_UNRATIFIED”) is directly contradicted by the mutant’s own reasoning. Any implementing lane that reaches this contradiction must treat it as itself a STOP condition under RULE_FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNKNOWN, never as a licence to prefer the more permissive reading.
